fixture_boundary: Structural checks compare the fixed native source driver and proof-shadow driver, exact selected production source markers and constructor body, actual Shared fields/Drop body/no-drop guard, refcount helper bodies, module paths, generated extraction outputs, and native harness crate/client paths when supplied. The proof facade's selected constructor, slice, clone, cleanup, and free helper bodies are compared against fixed normalized token patterns; only the two reviewed registration reifications may be trusted, and driver attributes are exact. These checks do not prove facade contracts or helper VCs, generic scope/cursor/receipt TCB adequacy, native MIR/Ghost erasure/callback correspondence, arbitrary concurrency, automatic Drop, or full Bytes admission. Prover semantic negative controls are archived separately.
